themes: Safety, and the product acting on its own

entries.title: An operator's uploads credit is bounded.
entries.body: A host's live credits together never pass one more of her plan's own uploads allowance (Free 300 MB, a pass 50 GB, Pro 100, 200 or 500 GB a month), at most ten at once, and each ends with its month or pass window; every credit asks a reason and the operator's second factor, and is logged.
entries.changeIf: a credit should be larger, last longer, or need two operators.

entries.title: A Disposable's develop turns its album, even while it takes uploads.
entries.body: Every album reads newest first while open and in the night's order once its host closes adding (AY1); a Disposable's develop, the moment she chose, turns it too, and a reopen after the develop keeps it in order.
entries.changeIf: a Disposable should stay newest first until she closes, like any album.

entries.title: Leaving Partyreel
entries.body: keeps her photos in other people's albums unless she ticks "Also remove…".
entries.changeIf: leaving should take her photos by default.

entries.title: A guest's "remove my photo" leaves for good that night
entries.body: on every album, where a host's own delete waits 30 days in Deleted.
entries.changeIf: a guest's removal should wait 30 days too.

entries.title: An open report pauses deletion:
entries.body: a reported album cannot be permanently deleted until the report closes, whatever its date in Deleted, and our evidence copy stays.
entries.changeIf: a host's own deletion should always finish on time.

entries.title: A copy in a host's Google Drive stays hers after a takedown:
entries.body: we delete nothing in her Drive, and our access reaches only the files we made.
entries.changeIf: you want an audited "Delete our copy from her Drive" before launch.

entries.title: No Follow is offered across a block, either way,
entries.body: so a person can infer that someone blocked them, though the page never says which side.
entries.changeIf: Follow should stay offered and fail quietly, keeping every block invisible.

entries.title: Make one like this lends an album's style alone.
entries.body: Its mode, its code's look and a Disposable's roll go into the visitor's own Create, read through the album's door as the visitor she is, so an album that shuts her out lends nothing; never its name, date, guests, photos or develop time.
entries.changeIf: it should lend more (its cover, its date), or ask the host before lending anything.

entries.title: What waits to send stays on her phone up to 14 days.
entries.body: A photo she sent with no line is kept in her browser for that album until it lands, then put down; past 14 days it is put down unread at her next open (Safari may clear it sooner), and on a shared phone what was kept for another account is deleted unsent.
entries.changeIf: it should wait longer, or a shared phone should keep it for its owner's next visit.

entries.title: The Terms name no idle window and no warning lead.
entries.body: A Free event idle for two years is removed after a warning email 14 days before, as the app and help say; the Terms and the Privacy Policy say only that a long-idle Free event may be removed after a warning, so either number can change without breaking a promise.
entries.changeIf: the Terms should state the window or the warning's lead.

entries.title: An operator's log of an account goes with the account.
entries.body: Every operator act on an account (an uploads credit today) is logged in admin_actions; when the account is deleted, its log entries are deleted with it, so nothing of that account outlives a deletion request.
entries.changeIf: the log should outlive the account, keeping the act with a plain account id.

entries.theme: Safety, and the product acting on its own
entries.title: The instant hide
entries.body: (a report that hides a photo at once): one address can hide 3 items a day, one event can lose 5 a day, and a host never triggers it on her own event; when you dismiss the report, the photo comes back (J4).
entries.changeIf: the limits feel off, or a hidden photo should stay down until you look.

entries.theme: Safety, and the product acting on its own
entries.title: Strikes:
entries.body: every dismissed child-abuse report counts against its reporter, even one that hid nothing, and the third dismiss needs no extra confirm.
entries.changeIf: only reports that hid something should count, or the third should ask.

entries.theme: Safety, and the product acting on its own
entries.title: The spend watch
entries.body: checks our usage daily (hourly at launch) and alerts you past ten times the week's busiest day; on its own it pauses only reminders, Download all, Drive and the nightly cleanup until a person lifts it. Uploads only alert (M2: a false alarm must never stop a party), beside your one-press switch that stops guests' uploads.
entries.changeIf: ten times is too loose, a pause should lift itself, or a runaway album should stop itself.

entries.theme: Safety, and the product acting on its own
entries.title: A guest's own uploads are capped at 1,000 files an hour.
entries.body: Counted on her ticket before each presign, a twentieth of her host's hourly breaker, so one script cannot spend the breaker for every other guest; past it she waits, told in her own words, and a failure of the count lets her through.
entries.changeIf: the cap should be higher, lower, or shared across one person's devices.

entries.theme: Safety, and the product acting on its own
entries.title: A block reaches a quiet lit page within 5 minutes.
entries.body: An open album's "has anything changed?" answer is cached at the CDN for a few seconds, so a page that trusts it asks the album itself at least every 5 minutes; a guest blocked while her lit page sees no change is turned away at that ask, or at once on any change or reload.
entries.changeIf: a block should reach her sooner (more calls), or 15 minutes is enough (fewer).
